recipes.title: Indian chicken jalfrezi with rice, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Indian chicken jalfrezi with peppers, onion and tomato in a bright ginger-cumin sauce, served with a modest portion of rice.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken breast, bell pepper, onion, garlic, ginger and cilantro in their listed forms.
Stir the cumin, paprika and salt together.
Coat the chicken breast with half the spice mixture.
Rest the chicken breast so the seasoning adheres.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan.
Brown the chicken breast until nearly cooked through.
Transfer the chicken breast to a clean plate.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the pan.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Cook the bell pepper until tender at the edges.
Stir the garlic, ginger and remaining spice mixture into the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and vegetable broth.
Simmer the jalfrezi sauce until thick and glossy.
Return the chicken breast to the sauce.
Simmer until the chicken breast is cooked through.
Stir the lemon juice into the jalfrezi.
Finish the Indian chicken jalfrezi with the cilantro.
Serve the chicken jalfrezi with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the chicken jalfrezi and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat gently until the chicken is steaming. Freeze the jalfrezi without the rice for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Italian stuffed mushrooms, light
recipes.summary: Baked mushroom caps filled with spinach, basil, bread and parmesan over a bright tomato sauce. Less cheese and oil keep this Italian snack lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the mushrooms, bread, parmesan cheese, spinach, onion, garlic and basil in their listed forms.
Pulse the bread in a food processor until coarse crumbs form.
Heat half the olive oil in a wide frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic into the onion until fragrant.
Cook the chopped mushroom stems until their moisture evaporates.
Fold the spinach into the mushroom stems until wilted and fairly dry.
Mix the bread crumbs, eggs, half the parmesan cheese, basil, spinach mixture and half the salt.
Brush the mushroom caps with the remaining olive oil.
Fill the mushroom caps with the bread and spinach mixture.
Stir the tomatoes, canned, tomato paste and remaining salt together in a baking dish.
Arrange the stuffed mushrooms over the tomato sauce.
Scatter the remaining parmesan cheese over the mushrooms.
Bake until the mushrooms are tender and the tops are crisp and golden.
Rest the Italian stuffed mushrooms before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat in a hot oven until the filling is crisp and the mushrooms are steaming. Freeze the baked stuffed mushrooms for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Italian egg and pepper panini, light
recipes.summary: Crisp Italian-style panini filled with soft eggs, peppers, spinach and tomato. Less bread, cheese and oil keep this breakfast lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the bread, bell pepper, onion, spinach, basil and garlic in their listed forms.
Heat half the olive oil in a wide frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Cook the bell pepper until tender at the edges.
Stir the garlic into the vegetables until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, to the pan.
Simmer the tomato mixture until thick and spoonable.
Fold the spinach into the tomato mixture until wilted.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a bowl.
Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the remaining olive oil in the pan.
Fold the eggs gently until softly set.
Layer the vegetable mixture over half the bread slices.
Spoon the eggs over the vegetables.
Scatter the parmesan cheese and basil over the eggs.
Cover each filling with a remaining bread slice.
Toast the panini in the dry pan until the first sides are crisp and golden.
Turn the panini carefully.
Toast until the second sides are golden and the parmesan cheese has melted.
Rest the Italian egg and pepper panini briefly before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served freshly toasted. Refrigerate the egg and vegetable fillings separately for up to 2 days. Reheat the filling gently and assemble with fresh bread. Do not freeze.

recipes.title: Italian pork and white bean stew, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Italian stew with pork loin, white beans, potatoes and vegetables in a tomato, thyme and basil broth.

steps.instruction: Prepare the pork loin, potato, carrot, celery, onion, garlic and basil in their listed forms.
Heat half the olive oil in a large saucepan.
Brown the pork loin on several sides.
Transfer the pork loin to a clean plate.
Heat the remaining olive oil in the saucepan.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery until soft and lightly golden.
Stir the garlic, tomato paste, thyme and salt into the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and vegetable broth.
Bring the stew to a gentle simmer.
Add the potato to the saucepan.
Simmer until the potato is nearly tender.
Return the pork loin to the stew.
Add the white beans to the saucepan.
Simmer until the pork loin is tender and the broth is rich and spoonable.
Stir the basil into the Italian pork and white bean stew.
Rest the stew so the flavours settle.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 4 days and reheat gently until the pork is steaming. Freeze the stew for up to 3 months; the potatoes will soften slightly after thawing.

recipes.title: Brazilian chicken and potato stew, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Brazilian chicken stew with potatoes, peppers and carrots in a bright tomato, paprika, lime and cilantro broth.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, potato, bell pepper, carrot, onion, garlic, lime and cilantro in their listed forms.
Stir the paprika, cumin and salt together.
Coat the chicken thigh with half the spice mixture.
Rest the chicken thigh so the seasoning adheres.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large saucepan.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Transfer the chicken thigh to a clean plate.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the saucepan.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Cook the bell pepper and carrot until they begin to soften.
Stir the garlic, tomato paste and remaining spice mixture into the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and chicken broth.
Bring the stew to a gentle simmer.
Add the potato to the saucepan.
Return the chicken thigh to the stew.
Simmer the covered stew until the chicken thigh and potato are tender.
Simmer uncovered until the broth thickens slightly.
Stir the lime juice into the Brazilian chicken and potato stew.
Finish the stew with the cilantro.
Rest the stew so the flavours settle.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat gently until the chicken is steaming. Freeze the stew for up to 2 months; the potatoes will soften slightly after thawing.
